story.title: Tennessee Governor Supports Proposal to Rename Nashville Airport for Dolly Parton
story.summary: Tennessee's governor has endorsed a proposal to rename Nashville International Airport in honor of Dolly Parton. This initiative has gained momentum following an online petition launched by fans in January 2025, which has since garnered over 155,000 signatures, particularly after Parton's recent passing.

timeline_highlights.title: Nashville Airport to Be Renamed in Honor of Dolly Parton Following Governor's Proposal
timeline_highlights.summary: Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has announced a proposal to rename Nashville International Airport in honor of Dolly Parton. This initiative comes after a fan-led petition, which gained significant traction following Parton's recent death, garnered over 155,000 signatures. The proposal is set to be discussed at the Metro Nashville Airport Authority's meeting on September 17.

event_overview.title: About Nashville Airport to Be Renamed in Honor of Dolly Parton Following Governor's Proposal
event_overview.subject: Nashville Airport to Be Renamed in Honor of Dolly Parton Following Governor's Proposal
event_overview.summary: This event concerns a proposal announced on August 28, 2026, to rename Nashville International Airport (BNA) in honor of Dolly Parton. As of August 29, the airport had not been renamed: Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee and the airport authority had expressed intent to pursue the tribute, with the authority’s naming policy and the proposal still awaiting consideration.

facts.label: Proposal status
facts.value: Gov. Bill Lee and Nashville International Airport announced their intent to name BNA in Dolly Parton’s honor on August 28, 2026; the announcement described a proposed tribute rather than a completed name change.

facts.label: Decision-making body
facts.value: Nashville International Airport is owned and operated by the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority (MNAA). Its seven-member Board of Commissioners governs the authority and sets its policies.

facts.label: Next stated consideration
facts.value: The Governor’s Office said MNAA’s current Naming Policy and the governor’s proposal would be addressed at an MNAA meeting on September 17, 2026.

facts.label: Existing naming-policy framework
facts.value: MNAA’s 2023 naming-policy materials state that naming facilities or property requires Board approval by resolution; for an individual honoree, the policy revision increased the usual period after death from two years to 10 years.

facts.label: Airport and location
facts.value: The airport under discussion is Nashville International Airport, also known as BNA, a Middle Tennessee airport located at One Terminal Drive, Nashville, Tennessee.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the August 28-29, 2026 announcement and gubernatorial support for the proposal, not any later MNAA vote, policy change, federal aviation action, or implementation of a new airport name.

related_stories.title: Former White House Staffer Fined for Insider Betting on Trump Speeches
related_stories.summary: A former White House teleprompter operator has been ordered to pay $172,000 after it was determined he used insider knowledge to place bets on President Trump's speeches. The staffer was placed on unpaid leave following the discovery of his actions, which involved betting on the content of the president's remarks.

related_stories.title: Local Businesses Resist Name Change of Lake Ontario Amid Trump's Executive Order
related_stories.summary: President Trump signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America.' However, businesses around Niagara Falls have expressed their intention to retain the original name. In response to the order, Ontario Premier Doug Ford plans to unveil a new sign for Lake Ontario in Winona, Ontario.
